body.text: Projects don't end when the work ships. The handoff, the final invoice, the testimonial ask — that's the part that pays for the next project, and it's the part most freelancers skip. WrapWell is a close-out system so nothing falls through the cracks after delivery.

Track every close-out step for each project: deliverables handed over, credentials transferred or revoked, final invoice sent, then the four asks that build your pipeline — testimonial, review, referral, retainer offer. A staged message writer drafts each ask for you, day 0 through day 30, ready to copy and send.

items: Solo freelancers closing 1–8 projects a month
Micro-agencies whose handoffs are ad hoc
Anyone whose portfolio hasn't been updated in months
Anyone still "meaning to ask" for testimonials
Add each finished project with its final invoice
Work the close-out checklist until the progress bar is full
Generate each staged ask and send it on schedule
Collect answers in the testimonial wall and embed them on your site
Nudge overdue invoices with one polite message

body.text: WrapWell is $12 a month, or $60 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.

description: WrapWell is the freelancer project close-out system: a wrap-up checklist per project (deliverables, credentials, invoice), a staged message writer for testimonial, review, referral, and retainer asks, a testimonial wall with embed code, and polite overdue-invoice nudges. Everything runs in your browser — no accounts, no integrations.

Staged ask writer: day 0 testimonial, day 7 review, day 21 referral, day 30 retainer
Guided testimonial questions that actually get answers

Overdue final-invoice nudge writer with aging
Everything saved in your browser — no sign-in needed
